about:
Furniture Source operates a retail showroom at 1542 N.W. 86th Street in Clive, Iowa, serving the greater Des Moines area. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in its public materials.

The store carries a range of residential furniture including living room, dining room, bedroom, mattress, home office, and entertainment center collections. Brands featured include Ashley and Global Furniture, with product lines such as power recliners, lift chairs, sofas, loveseats, and sectionals. The retailer offers financing options, delivery service, and a return policy; some items are noted as requiring no assembly.

Furniture Source sells directly to consumers through its physical location and website. Its customer base consists of household shoppers seeking mid‑range to upscale home furnishings. The company does not list commercial or contract‑furniture clients.

The business emphasizes its tenure in the furniture trade and highlights “outstanding customer service before and after the sale” as a core differentiator. It also promotes a “Shop Local” message encouraging community support.
